bio.text: Marc Snyder, a Democrat, represents District 12 (El Paso and Teller counties) in the Colorado State Senate.
He has held the Senate seat since January 2025, after serving in the Colorado House of Representatives (District 18) from 2019 to 2025.
He lives in Manitou, Colorado, and earned a law degree from Emory University in 1987.
His career experience includes working as a private practice attorney.
